title: Sprint G1 - registry lifecycle and link delink semantics
description: SPRINT BRIEF (phase 0). Make the machine-local project registry the reliable foundation everything else keys off. Today (packages/core/src/project-registry.ts): entries carry paths and display metadata, ids are not guaranteed stable across unlink and relink, there are no lifecycle states (registry doctor reports path drift only as a warning), and bwrk global link and unlink exist in the command surface (apps/cli/src/command-registry.ts line 666) but their semantics are not contractual. This sprint delivers: stable project ids derived from project identity rather than insertion, lifecycle states linked paused archived missing, and link or delink semantics that are non-invasive (linking writes nothing into the target repo) and reversible (unlink soft-archives by default and preserves reference resolution; purge is explicit). No dependency on other sprints - this is pure registry work and can start immediately.
